# Resolver

Asks name servers for a host's addresses.

```rux
pub struct Resolver {
    // private fields
}
```

Not copied.
A query goes to each server in turn, for the IPv4 addresses and then the IPv6 ones, until a server answers;
the whole round is tried again as many times as the attempts allow. Each query waits for its answer up to the
timeout, and a name the server says does not exist ends the lookup at once.

## Associated functions

<h3 id="with-servers"><code>WithServers</code></h3>

```rux
pub func WithServers(
    allocator: Allocator,
    servers: SocketAddress[..]
) -> Resolver
```

A resolver that asks `servers`, waiting five seconds for each answer and going round them twice.

| Name        | Type                | Description                                                         |
| ----------- | ------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `allocator` | `Allocator`         | what the server list and every lookup's results are kept in         |
| `servers`   | `SocketAddress[..]` | the name servers, in the order they are asked; port 53 is DNS's own |

**Returns**: the resolver

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Net/Src/Dns.rux#L152)

<h3 id="from-system"><code>FromSystem</code></h3>

```rux
pub func FromSystem(allocator: Allocator) -> Resolver
```

A resolver configured as the C library's would be: the name servers, and the `timeout` and `attempts`
options, of `/etc/resolv.conf` on Linux. With no servers to read, the one on this machine is asked.

| Name        | Type        | Description                                                 |
| ----------- | ----------- | ----------------------------------------------------------- |
| `allocator` | `Allocator` | what the server list and every lookup's results are kept in |

**Returns**: the resolver

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Net/Src/Dns.rux#L164)

<h3 id="lookup"><code>Lookup</code></h3>

```rux
pub func Lookup(
    self: &Resolver,
    allocator: Allocator,
    host: char8[..],
    port: uint16
) -> Vector<SocketAddress> ! IoError
```

Asks the servers for `host`'s addresses: its IPv4 addresses first, then its IPv6 ones, each with `port`.
The hosts file is not read; [`Resolve`](/docs/api/net/resolve#resolve) reads it first.

| Name        | Type        | Description                     |
| ----------- | ----------- | ------------------------------- |
| `allocator` | `Allocator` | what the list is kept in        |
| `host`      | `char8[..]` | the name, such as `example.com` |
| `port`      | `uint16`    | the port every address gets     |

**Returns**: the addresses; `NotFound` when the name has none or does not exist, `TimedOut` when no server answered

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Net/Src/Dns.rux#L189)
